title: Edge browser profiles
whyItMatters: Each profile is a separate browsing identity. Profile names and the accounts signed into Edge show who used this computer and which work or personal accounts were linked.
source: Chromium user data directory docs (Edge uses the Chromium layout): https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/main/docs/user_data_dir.md
notes: Matches the Preferences marker file so non-profile folders (Crash Reports, ShaderCache) are skipped. Looked for on this PC: exists.
